description: Angular component for an API Usage Widget in the Thingsboard platform, managing data subscriptions, UI styles, and data formatting.

classes.name: ApiUsageWidgetComponent

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the widget, sets up data subscriptions, and prepares styles.

methods.name: ngOnDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up resources such as disconnecting resize observers.

methods.name: updateState
